why_this_exists.what_the_audit_found: analysis/deep-research/DIRECTION-SYMMETRY-AUDIT-2026-08-09.md -- FOUR of four asymmetric numeric knobs in live config make CALLS harder than PUTS, and not one makes a put harder. This is the largest of them and the one at the top of the entry funnel.
why_this_exists.the_specific_asymmetry: automation/state/params.json: filter_10_min_triggers_bull = 2 vs filter_10_min_triggers_bear = 1. A call must show TWICE the confirming triggers a put must show, on the same engine, same bar, same levels.

hypothesis: Setting filter_10_min_triggers_bull from 2 to 1 (parity with bear) admits a cohort of bull entries whose per-trade expectancy is not worse than the currently-admitted bull cohort -- i.e. the second-trigger requirement is filtering on a criterion that does not discriminate winners from losers on the bull side.
the_null_that_would_kill_it: The added single-trigger bull cohort is materially WORSE than the 2-trigger cohort, meaning the second trigger IS doing real quality work on bull and the asymmetry is EARNED. That is a perfectly good outcome and closes the question -- it converts an inherited asymmetry into a chosen one.
why_this_knob_first: It is ONE INTEGER -- the cheapest possible test of the largest asymmetry.

It sits at the TOP of the entry funnel, so it gates volume, and volume is the binding constraint on the $100-200/day/account target (the core binary population is ~1.4 trades/day; no per-trade edge reaches the target at that rate).
Its bear counterpart is ALREADY 1 and has been trading at 1 the whole time -- so the counterfactual is not exotic; it is the setting the other direction already runs.
populations: A: the 399-day replay, bull entries only, filter_10 at min_triggers 2 (control) vs 1 (parity). Sequential one-position NOT_FLAT walk, real cached OPRA fills, exits via exit_manager_walk.walk_exit_manager ONLY (never simulator_real).

B: the ADDED cohort in isolation -- bull entries admitted at 1 trigger that would have been REFUSED at 2. This is the cohort whose quality is actually in question; reporting only the blended total would hide it.
gates: G_ADDED_COHORT: the ADDED bull cohort's own per-trade expectancy > 0. This is the primary gate -- a blended improvement driven entirely by the pre-existing 2-trigger trades proves nothing about the knob.
G_NO_DEGRADE: total bull expectancy at parity >= expectancy at 2 triggers
G_DROP_BEST: G_ADDED_COHORT survives removing its single best day (the book's entire 27-day bull P&L is currently one Tuesday -- a one-day-driven result is the specific failure mode here)
G_TUESDAY: no degradation of 2026-08-04, reported per cell and marked NOT EVALUABLE rather than passed if that date is absent from the cohort
BH-FDR q=0.10 across every cell this study tests
kill_criteria: G_ADDED_COHORT fails -> the second trigger is earning its keep on bull; CLOSE the question and record the asymmetry as VALIDATED rather than inherited.
Added cohort is positive ONLY on the blended number -> treated as a fail, not a pass.

ship_rule.what_a_pass_buys: A pre-registered single-arm forward trial (one paper arm, one integer, documented one-line revert) -- the same shape as the risky-3 stop_mode arming. NOT a fleet-wide or core-account flip.
ship_rule.explicitly_not_authorized: Changing filter_10_min_triggers_bull on automation/state/params.json (core Safe, J's primary account) on the strength of a replay study alone.
ship_rule.revert_if_ever_armed: set filter_10_min_triggers_bull back to 2 -- one integer, byte-identical, next tick.

sequencing_note: This is INDEPENDENT of the risky-3 stop_mode trial and of prereg LADDER-X-PREMIUM (which is blocked on it). It touches the ENTRY admission side, not the exit shape, so it can be measured without waiting on the stop_mode forward result. If both eventually pass they must be re-tested JOINTLY before any combined arming -- stacking two separately-validated changes without measuring their interaction is how the 0-for-12 happened.
reporting_rule: Every cell reported including failures. If the added cohort is negative, that result is written down and the asymmetry is relabelled VALIDATED -- an unrun or quietly-dropped pre-registration is indistinguishable from a hidden negative.
